output.summary: A large succulent native to Jalisco, Colima, Nayarit, Michoacán and Aguascalientes in Mexico. It has spiky, fleshy leaves and sends up a tall, yellow-flowered stalk before dying. Only the Weber Azul cultivar supplies tequila: its mature heart is heated, pressed, fermented and distilled.
output.edibilityNote: The heated heart of the Weber Azul cultivar is pressed, and its sugary liquid is fermented and distilled into tequila.
